undefeated.translation: a. （选手或运动队）未被打败过的, 未输过的; 不败

undefendable.definition: s not defended or capable of being defended
undefendable.translation: a. 无法防御的, 不能保卫的, 不可辩解的

undefended.definition: s not defended or capable of being defended
undefended.translation: a. 无防御的, 无论据证实的, 无辩护人的

undefended suit.translation: [法] 无抗辩的诉案, 不作辩护的诉讼

undefiled.definition:
s free from stain or blemish
s (of language) not having its purity or excellence debased
undefiled.translation: a. 未污损的, 洁净的, 洁白的, 纯正的

undefinable.definition: s not capable of being precisely or readily described; not easily put into words
undefinable.translation: a. 不能下定义的, 不确定的

undefine.definition:
v. t. To make indefinite; to obliterate or confuse the
   definition or limitations of.
undefine.translation: vt. 未定义；未赋值；命令取消

undefined.definition: a. not precisely limited, determined, or distinguished
undefined.translation:
a. 不明确的, 未下定义的
[法] 未阐明的, 未解释的, 不确定的, 不明确的

undefined operation.translation: [计] 未定义运算, 未定义操作

undefined record.translation: [计] 未定界记录, 不定长记录

undeflected.translation: a. 不偏离的,不偏斜的
